og_title: America's cyber agency: hackers are using the flaw under most websites | Warning Shots
og_desc: America's cyber agency (CISA) added two of the PHP flaws to its list of flaws known to be used in real attacks on Oct 26, and gave federal agencies until Oct 29 to fix them. It named no victim, and no organization has confirmed a breach, so this stays Proven, not Hit. Severe AI incidents went from 3 to 13 in a year. In 41% of this year's real-world cases the AI itself did the acting. 164 incidents since 2023, scored 0–100 and sourced. Live tracking of PHP2Shell, 20 dated forecasts, and what officials have said. Updated Oct 27, 10:45 AM ET.
